audit.why: 53.44% over 784 games with Illaoi favoured through the laning phase; difficulty text (7.5/10) is aggressive for a winning matchup but the lane description matches the kits: Ryze is immobile and Illaoi's whole pattern is available.
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty text left as-is; the level chart is what was wrong.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 3-5, level 6, first item, late — matching Illaoi's R at 120s rank 1 and Ryze's mana-scaling passive (Arcane Mastery). Only the level-6 chart row disagreed with them.
audit.corrected: Kept spike timings; corrected the chart rows that contradicted them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison is described repeatedly as 'his point-blank root' with no mention of its condition, and spikes[1] claims Ryze has 'no Realm Warp escape in a 1v1'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rune Prison (W, 615 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) damages and SLOWS; it only roots if the target already has Flux from E Spell Flux (615 range, 3.5s at rank 1). Dodging or cleansing the Flux application is the whole counterplay and it was never stated. Realm Warp (R, 3000 range, 180/160/140s) creates a portal that teleports allies near it after a delay — Ryze can stand on it himself, so it is an escape, just a slow-telegraphed one.
audit.corrected: State the Flux precondition on Rune Prison and stop asserting Realm Warp cannot save him.

audit.why: Rune Prison at 11s rank 1 is genuinely the punishable cooldown; the text already keys engages to it. Added the real number.
audit.corrected: Engage on the 11s Rune Prison window.

audit.why: 53.44% Emerald+ over 784 games, consistent with the Illaoi-favoured laning text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart said Ryze wins Level 1, Level 6 and loses 2+ items, while every why[] and spike said the opposite.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Illaoi for rows 0-5 and Ryze for row 6; whys[0] ('Ryze's immobile, squishy Level 1 lets you threaten free Tentacle slams'), whys[4] ('R Leap of Faith at 6 erases the spacing his Q poke depends on') and whys[6] ('Late, Ryze's completed mana core...') all agree with the packet, not with the sides.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 0, 4 and 6 in both layers as one atomic group.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Ryze's mana core turns Flux into a root-chain — close with your side-lane pattern before he outscales you.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It only roots if his E Spell Flux is on you — clean, it is a slow. Dodge Flux, engage on its 11s.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through E Spell Flux — clean, it just slows. Dodge Flux, then E him on the 11s window and slam.

edits.before: R Leap of Faith gaps the distance his Q Overload poke tries to keep, dropping a Tentacle wall on him with no Realm Warp escape in a 1v1.
edits.after: R Leap of Faith closes the gap his Q Overload poke needs and spawns a Tentacle per champion hit; Realm Warp only saves him if he casts it early.

notes: Illaoi kit flags misfire here: R Leap of Faith carries 'grounding' and 'untargetable' flags and E Test of Spirit carries 'slow' — none of that is in Riot's descriptions for those spells, so no advice was written on them. Left the 7.5/10 difficulty alone despite a 53.44% win rate; it may deserve a review at champion level.
